name: Auto Itinerary
author: TeamCastaldi
description: Turns emailed business-trip calendar invites into live TREK trips automatically.

settings.label: Webhook shared secret
settings.hint: TREK plugin routes carry no request headers, so this must be passed as a query parameter: configure Resend's webhook URL as https://<trek-host>/api/resend-webhook?secret=<this value>. Requests with a missing/mismatched secret are rejected.

settings.label: Resend API key
settings.hint: Used to fetch attachment content after the webhook fires — Resend's webhook payload only carries attachment metadata, not the .ics bytes themselves.

settings.label: TREK base URL
settings.hint: Public APP_URL of this TREK instance, e.g. https://trek.example.com. Used for both /oauth/token and /mcp.

settings.label: MCP machine client ID
settings.hint: Created under Settings -> Integrations -> MCP -> OAuth Clients -> Machine client.
